messages.text: Hi Rajesh, following up on your inquiry about our semi-automatic pouch filling machine. Attached the brochure.
Thanks. Looks good. What's the price for a 50-pouch/min model with CE certification?
The MPF-50C is quoted at Rs 8.5L ex-works. Delivery in 3 weeks.
Can you send a formal quote on letterhead? We want to place order by end of month.
Hi Priya, met you at the Dairy Expo last week. Sharing our dairy pouch packaging catalogue as promised.
Thanks. We're evaluating 2-3 vendors. Our volume is 10,000 pouches/day. What capacity do you recommend?
For 10k/day I'd suggest the DP-120 model, 120 pouches/min. Happy to arrange a demo at our Pune facility.
A demo would help. Let me check with my technical team and get back by Friday.
Hi Vikram, you filled our website form regarding spice packaging solutions. Can I understand your requirement?
Yes, we export turmeric and chili powder. Need vacuum packaging machine for 500g to 5kg pouches.
Our VP-500 handles 500g to 5kg range. I'll send specs and pricing today.
Please do. Also mention if you have GST-inclusive pricing and installation support in Kerala.
Hi Anjali, Prakash from Reddy Industries referred you. Understand you need blister packaging for tablets?
Yes correct. We're setting up a new line, output 50,000 blisters/day. Budget around 15-20L.
Our BP-500 series fits that spec. I'll put together a proposal with GMP compliance details.
Great. We also need to finalize vendor by Nov 15. Please share references of pharma clients using your machines.
Hi Sameer, following up on your WhatsApp inquiry about bottle labeling machines.
Yes, we need wrap-around labeler for 500ml and 1L PET bottles. 60 bottles/min capacity.
I'll send our WL-60 specs. Lead time is 4 weeks currently.
Okay send details. We're also talking to 2 other vendors so will take 2-3 weeks to decide.
Hi Deepa, sharing the chocolate wrapping machine quote - CW-80 at Rs 12L ex-works.
The machine looks right but the price is on the higher side. Can we work out something around 10L?
I can bring it down to 11.2L with standard warranty, or 10.5L if you take basic warranty only. Which works?
Let's go with 10.8L and standard warranty. Also need payment split 50-50, advance and on delivery. Can you confirm?
Hi Arjun, from Pack Expo. Sharing details on our bottling line as discussed.
Thanks. Will review and share with my team.
Hi Arjun, any initial thoughts? Happy to clarify any questions.
Hi Meera, received your website inquiry about herbal powder packaging. What's your target output?
Need to pack churna powders in 100g and 250g sachets. Around 5000 sachets/day initially.
Hi Rakesh, cold outreach - we provide grain processing packaging solutions. Would it be useful to connect?
We already have a vendor but open to alternatives. Send me a brochure.
Sent. Let me know if you'd like a call to discuss.
Hi Sunita, Vikas from Lotus Beauty referred me. Heard you're expanding your cosmetics line - sharing our tube filling machine details.
Yes we're adding a new SKU - face serums in 30ml tubes. Will go through the details and come back.
Hi Harish, sharing details on our pickle jar filling + capping line - PJ-40 model.
Need details on power consumption, machine footprint, and whether it handles both glass and PET jars. Also what's the changeover time between SKUs?
Great questions. Power 3kW, footprint 2.4m x 1.8m, handles both glass and PET with changeover kit. Full changeover ~45 min. I'll send the technical datasheet.
Datasheet received. Can we schedule a technical call with your engineer? Want to understand after-sales service and spare parts availability in Nashik.
Hi Lakshmi, from the trade show. Sharing details on our snack packaging line as requested.
Thanks. I'll go through.
Hi Lakshmi, any thoughts? Happy to arrange a facility visit.
Hi Lakshmi, following up again. Please let me know if there's interest.
Hi Nitin, sharing the quote for the oil pouch filling line - OP-100 at Rs 18L.
Honestly the price is way above our budget. We were looking at 10-12L range max.
I hear you. The OP-100 is our premium line. We have the OP-60 at Rs 11L which handles lower volumes but same quality - would that fit?
Send me the OP-60 spec sheet. If it fits our volume needs, this could work.
Hi Pooja, following up from the Tea Expo. Sharing our tea packaging solutions.
Thanks. We're not actively looking right now, maybe next quarter after our new facility opens.
Understood Pooja. I'll check back in January as suggested.
Hi Suresh, you filled our form about flour packaging automation.
Just exploring options. Will reach out when we're ready.
Hi Suresh, any update?
Hi Suresh, checking in once more. Let me know when you want to resume.
Hi Shilpa, following up on your WhatsApp inquiry about dry fruit packaging.
Yes, we need vacuum sealing for cashews and almonds. 250g, 500g and 1kg packs.
Our VS-100 handles all three pack sizes. Sending quote today.
Hi Prakash, Ravi from Nair Cashews referred me. Understand you need vacuum packaging for cashew exports?
Yes, exporting to Middle East. Need USFDA-compliant machine, 100g to 1kg packs, around 2000 packs/day.
Our VP-200X is USFDA certified and handles that range. I'll send specs and schedule a call.
Perfect. Also need to know about export documentation support and training for our operators.
Hi Ritu, met you at the Namkeen Expo. Sharing our snack filling line details.
Thanks. Will circulate internally.
Hi Ritu, following up - any thoughts from your team?
